context: Hibiscus sabdariffa extract inhibits obesity and fat accumulation, and improves liver steatosis in humans. Obesity is associated with a great diversity of diseases including non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Our previous report suggested that Hibiscus sabdariffa extracts (HSE) had a metabolic-regulating and liver-protecting potential.
target: In this study, we performed a clinical trial to further confirm the effect of HSE.
